see your calendar list, and create the Latch calendar
create tasks and see your task lists
Nothing else. Not Gmail, not Drive, not Contacts.

Everything Latch saves lands in one calendar of its own. One colour, one tick box to show or hide it all in Google Calendar, and a whole batch can be undone at once.
The calendar is created when you finish setup. Leave now and nothing is added to your Google account.
